title: IncomingSearchV1 — typed INPUT that source universe S searched target universe U at relation@rung (DRAFT)
description: Canonical-record INPUT. Not inferred from producer facts. Not an empty Cartesian Coverage key (S,U). Used only when no CoverageResultV3 exists with key (relation, minResolution, sourceUniverse=S, targetUniverse=U). Cannot override a represented Coverage S->U that is partial/unknown. Identity is raw SHA-256 of C(this record). Uniqueness: (planId, providerClosure, sourceUniverse, targetUniverse, relation, minResolution). Standing: isolated successor draft. Root registers the payload-registry / ProofInputRef row.

providerClosure.description: Plan-selected closure kind=provider that examined S. Not evaluator.

scopeRefs.description: Selected scopes of this relation at EXACT minResolution whose sourceUniverse is S. Any targetUniverse. These are the independently enumerated SOURCE subjects. Not a per-target-subject Cartesian.

expectedInventoryRefs.description: raw SHA-256 of C(SubjectInventoryV1) for S at the source kind. Partial/unavailable inventories are valid refs; they make population unknown rather than listing fake IDs.

completeSearch.description: true: this source's examination considered target U (whole-source-to-target-universe search, not per-subject Cartesian). false: search of U not established.

x-opensip-law.cartesian: FORBIDDEN. This record attests that source program S searched target universe U as a whole at relation@rung. It does not mint per-target-subject Coverage keys.
x-opensip-law.coverageFirst: If a CoverageResultV3 exists with exact (relation, minResolution, S, U), that Coverage is the search law. Partial/unknown Coverage cannot be overridden by completeSearch=true.
x-opensip-law.whenUsed: Only when no such Coverage exists. Then this admitted record may stand in for the missing S->U search. completeSearch=false or coverage=unknown leaves incoming absence unknown.
x-opensip-law.otherPartitions: Coverage/scopes S->V (V≠U) still count toward source-population union and must be sufficiency-accounted. They do not prove search of U.
joins: providerClosure is Plan-selected, closures[id].kind=provider, and is the enumerator of an available EnumerationPlan binding whose universe=S
every scopeRefs member exists, relation and resolution exact, sourceUniverse=S
every expectedInventoryRefs digest names an inputs.inventories record of universe S (locator digest supplied on the inventory as inventoryDigest)
